steps.name: Traces of the disappeared goddess
steps.objective: Go to the front of the “Sanctuary of the Covenant” and meet [Iris]. After checking what happened, report the quest to [Minuet] in “Adrica”.

lines.text: (When you arrive at the Sanctuary of the Covenant inside Sanctuary Eidos, a warm wind like the touch of Iris blows.)
(As I followed the wind and stood in front of the small road behind the Covenant Sanctuary, I suddenly felt like I was remembering a dream I had last night.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sure I had a dream, but I can't remember what it was about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let’s go meet Iris. You called me, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on? I don’t think there’s anything urgent right now… .
(The small light that comes with the wind takes the guest somewhere.)
(The brightly smiling figure of Iris approaches through the gap where the light approaches and disappears.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I thought I would miss you, but I didn't know you would come like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought Iris might be calling me... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Then you could have told me right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, is that so? Haha, I guess so.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I have something to tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Let's go meet Minuet.
(Iris carefully holds %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I have something to check from Minuet, the incarnation of Gaia.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: So, you must hold on to it. I don't know how it will fall this time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?
(Iris smiles mischievously at %s's reaction.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I feel sad when you make that surprised expression. So don't be too nervous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, yeah.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Shall we go then?
(After walking a few steps with Iris, an unfamiliar place comes into view. In addition, owners with familiar cries greeting them approach.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Wow, it’s full of pretty and cute phantom beasts.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, it's Adrika. Does Iris like animals?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes, I like it. As long as they don't attack first. I was often bitten and injured during the trip.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's the same for me too. At first, these kids thought I was a bad person, so they followed me and kept stabbing and biting me.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: We have no choice but to be wary of unfamiliar targets.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: There is something that these children particularly like. Among them, Levy... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Isn't it because he's kind?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Hehe, it seems like that. Oh, there's a minuet.
(You can see Minuet standing blankly far away from where the two people stopped.)
(Minuet recognizes the two people, blinks, and waves her hand as if she recognizes them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet? I open my mouth to speak, but I can't hear my voice... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: As expected... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Also?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Maybe it's because Gaia has gone far away, but she can't reach the minuet. They say minuet is okay, but... .
(Minuet looks at Iris with slightly blank eyes.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The absence of God also affects the incarnation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet… .
(Minuet holds %s's hand and blinks.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, do you know where Gaia is? I told you you went far.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Ah… . that is… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: talk to me

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I think he came briefly to meet Adkina and then left. So I found out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris do you know why Gaia did that?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's not exact, but I think he was trying to give me strength. I also want to talk to Gaia, but... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The place Gaia went to was a haven between Etoire and a certain world... . I can't leave this place empty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then can someone go instead?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: tell me Please.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes, I will tell you because I promised not to hide it.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I can go. But, it's dangerous. For the average person to go there, it is a space where all kinds of time and souls are intertwined... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll come back.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It’s dangerous!! It's a place to go with a human body... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll come see Gaia. You might be waiting.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Still… .
(Iris is speechless and then makes an expression saying there is nothing he can do.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I will allow it. It's just this one time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: When you're ready, come near the entrance to the Covenant Sanctuary. I'll be ready too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Minuet… , then wish %s good luck.
(As Minuet nods as if he understood, Iris smiles softly and quietly disappears from the scene.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If Iris talks like that, it must be a dangerous place. I need to prepare well and go. Then, Minuet, I will go too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will definitely come and meet Gaia... .

steps.name: where gaia is
steps.objective: Go to the “Sanctuary of the Covenant” once again and move to a new location. Then, report the quest to [Arke] in 「Pneuma」.

lines.text: (After completing the preparations and arriving in front of the entrance to the covenant sanctuary, the wind like the hand of Iris blows again.)
(However, unlike before, the wind blows and disappears repeatedly with an unstable feeling.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… ?

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: I'm fine. It's my first time using this power, so I'm just not used to it.

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: %s, let me ask you again. Does your intention to go there remain the same?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I am the same.

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: Close your eyes. Then I will send you there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Close your eyes, as Iris said.)

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: The place where %s's steps should reach is a place that embraces a different time from here... . Between the boundaries of time and space... .

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: Pneuma… .
(Iris's voice becomes blurred and can no longer be heard. Then, for a moment, what %s sees is distorted as if it were distorted.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what is it?
(Things in front of me are distorted, then come back again and again, and then stop. When I look up after some time, what is approaching me is an unfamiliar dark space.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where am I... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't hear Iris's voice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I can see a light over there. Is that where it goes? I have to go first.
(An unfamiliar space unfolds in front of %s, who was walking along the light. However, the approaching air does not seem unfamiliar.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's definitely a place I've seen for the first time... .
(A beautiful coastline unfolds through the approaching moonlight. Small stars are falling one after another on the clouds that seem to surround the island.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Beach… ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've never seen a beach like this, not even in Gendia, Freios, or Eastland... .
(Small waves arise as if to the beat of a cool breeze. Every time, beings hidden somewhere appear and wander around.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Spirit?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Even when they see me, they just pass by like nothing happened. Where are we going?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shall we follow along first? Who is there?

steps.name: A place full of spirits (1)
steps.objective: Defeat [Green Atmos] and [Kind Aerura] in “Pneuma” and report the quest to [Arke].

lines.text: (A girl is standing in front of a secluded place where she was followed by spirits whose appearance was not seen anywhere else.)
(The girl standing in the moonlight greets the spirits brightly when she sees them.)
You guys are here. Did you enjoy it?
Even if it's just a joke, don't try to bite it. I really hate being bitten to death.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey… .
This is my first time seeing a spirit.
(The girl strokes the spirits' heads and then also strokes %s's head. However, something seems strange, so she strokes again and then makes a puzzled expression.)
This is definitely hair... .
Hair?!
Wow!! Yes, it is a person!!
(The girl is startled and steps back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, don't be surprised. I'm not a bad person. No, saying things like this makes me seem like a bad person. Anyway, no!
… Sorry, sorry. It's not polite to be surprised by people. It’s been so long since I’ve seen anyone… . But who are you?
(The girl comes to her senses and looks at %s's face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My name is %s… , %s.
It's %s, %s. My name is Arche and I live here in Pneuma. It’s a pretty name, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a good name.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I've heard a lot about %s. No, I found out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is that... ?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: That… . Even if you stay here, you will learn about the spirits that have visited below because they will tell you their stories. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So does that mean Arche is a spirit? Spirit King? The spirits follow me well... . Or the incarnation of Gaia?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: No. I am neither a spirit nor an incarnation. I'm an ordinary human being. But isn't it strange that I can't leave here and only live here?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Hehe, the rest is a secret.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Secret… ?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Oh, what should I do? I think the spirits were surprised by the unfamiliar energy of %s. So, would you mind playing with me over there?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Just fight with the spirits like you would spar with Baldrick.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know Baldrick?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'll talk about that later. If you're late, the spirits might grab %s's hand and put you in some strange place that isn't Hell or Purgatory.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Then you will never see the light of day again.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: This is the rule here, so I can't help it as I live here. Because spirits have spirit rules, and humans have human rules.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It won't be difficult, so come play with those kids. I'll be waiting.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: … I will tell you the story of Iris and Gaia. Oops, it's a secret.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm a little suspicious... I don't know if it's true or not, but I can't help it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll come back first.

steps.name: A place full of spirits (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Dr. Theoria] and [Action Praxis] in “Pneuma” and report the quest to [Arke].

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: You played well with the spirits. Looking at the faces of the spirits, they look happy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It wasn't the same as sparring with Baldrick... . Now, please tell us the story of Iris and Gaia.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Before you do that, aren’t you curious about this place?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You said the name here is Pneuma, right? I'm sure Iris said that... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's a secret... . This place is also called pneuma, ‘space of breathing.’ In Etoire, ‘life’ has an impact on those who spend time there.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Do you see the spirits here?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The spirits work hard to create positive signals. Create good times and convey good feelings.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's definitely different from the time and space I live in, right? I talked about rules earlier... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: That's right. The flow itself is different.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it like the world of spirits or the spirit world?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Although there are many spirits, that cannot be said for sure.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's just words that I don't understand at all...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, the atmosphere here is very comfortable. It's peaceful.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The reason there is no bad energy is because of the blessings left behind by the ancient gods.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: But you can't stay here. If you stay like this, you can't go back to the original time.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Oh, it's a secret... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How much is it a secret?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's no secret that Gaia is here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I meet Gaia?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I can tell you where Gaia is, but %s cannot reach you.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I don’t know if you know, but Gaia is here… . uh?
(Suddenly, a huge number of spirits flock to where the two people are.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: What should I do? I think we need to calm down the spirits again. I guess %s has the power to attract spirits.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm just human... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: An ordinary human wouldn't have come all this way to talk to a goddess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what should I do?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: … Please play with the spirits one more time. It felt like I was being hit by the breath of Dragon Adkina.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Then you won't die?
(Arke pushes %s on his back and pushes him in front of the spirits.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Please come back quickly. That's how the time here calms down.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does it mean for time to calm down? Anyway, if we play this one more time, it will be over, right?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes, have fun with the spirits!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel like I'm taking a test, but I'll give it a try. Then tell me properly.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Come back!

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: (As Gaia also said….)

steps.name: To maintain daily life
steps.objective: Defeat [Kronos] in “The Time of Kronos.” Then report the quest to [Arke] in 「Pneuma」.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Thank you for your hard work. I think the spirits were satisfied this time too.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It looks a little difficult, but... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It was a little difficult this time.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Please sit here and rest for a moment. While you rest, the pneuma, the breathing space, will prepare to welcome %s.
(Arke quietly stretches out his hand towards the sky. The movement of the stars falling towards the sea stops and then disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s a beautiful sky….)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Now let's start the story.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: %s As you know, Gaia has exhausted her strength for the stars she loves and for those she loves.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: So, he was recovering by falling asleep and waking up repeatedly. During the awakening period, use your strength only where necessary.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: But this time, a lot happened to Gaia. The sanctuary was invaded, and we continued to encounter those who were targeting Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So, if anything happens to Gaia... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: As time goes by, the stars gradually forget Gaia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Forget?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's a secret, but since you're %s, I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Nothing lasts forever. All objects and life have a set time. The beloved star ‘Etoire’ also… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Even if the stars do not disappear, they forget the ancient gods who were with them. Now, there are only a handful of ancient gods left... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Every time the star loses its memories of the Old Gods, more evil beings will come.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: When Gaia appeared in the form of Minuet, if %s had not been there... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: And that would have happened if you hadn't saved Gaia from Barbatos in Eidos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The stars forget God…, so does God also forget the stars? Ah…?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Barbatos said he lost his memory.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, no.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche tells me everything, saying it's a secret. How much do you know?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's okay because I can tell you even if it's a secret to some extent. I was influenced by the passage of time and the in-between for a long time.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Pneuma is that kind of place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche, then you can now meet Gaia?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: We need permission from the spirit in charge of the two spaces, the realm of time that flows through our lives.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Only then can we go to see Gaia, who is between the two spaces.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The two spirits of time, Kronos and Kairos, divide and guard the space. Meet them and talk to them.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The two spirits probably recognize %s, who has received Gaia's blessing... . This much I can tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will try.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: First, go see Kronos. Kronos is in a space called ‘Kronos Time’ named after himself.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Go to where you see the tent down there. It's there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will meet Kronos right away. See you later.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes, I will wait here.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: (…Gaia, can %s really stop time?)
(When you enter the tent in the direction indicated by Arche, you see a different landscape from Pneuma.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth is here... ?
(The sky behind the giant stuffed animal, larger than the trees in the forest, is colored with a purple sunset. And in front of it, a strange Ferris wheel is spinning.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No… . They say space in time is something like that... . Amusement park?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's no one on that Ferris wheel. Are you running all night?
No, boo!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ow?
(A huge bird flies from the sky accompanied by a strange onomatopoeia. A being of a different form from a normal bird stares at %s's face.)
Even if you are a human being loved by God, you cannot come here. hoot!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Owl?
It looks like an owl, but it's not an owl, owl! My name is Kronos. It's the spirit of time, boo!
(An owl, or rather an owl-shaped clock, covering the boat with one wing introduces itself.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So is that what a clock looks like…?)
Tick. Tick.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I’m afraid it’s not a clock, I can even hear the sound of the second hand ticking.)

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: %s! Nice to meet you, boo! Iris This is your person, so speak comfortably, boo!
Ah, yes. The reason I came... .

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I know what's coming, boo. He said he came to meet Gaia.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: But, boo!
(Kronos thrusts the scythe he was holding in front of %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: What is it? hoot! I'm just doing what I have to do as the manager of this space, boo!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: To meet Gaia, you need Kronos' permission. So please allow me. Stop the time flowing here.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Want to stop time? If time stops here, what do you think will happen to your place, Iris? hoot?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, this place and that place... .

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: … That doesn't mean there isn't a way, but... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tell me how!
(Kronos takes away the scythe he was holding and points to the sky.)

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Feel all the time in this space.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you feel time?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: The passage of time should not be viewed simply. hoot! I manage this place, but I can't do anything carelessly!

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: That's because this place has a structure that helps all life in Etoire maintain their daily lives and normal times, boo!

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: The other spirits here are also working to make that time precious, boo.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what should I do?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I feel it with my whole body, boo! I will feel that time and think about it when it comes to where I am.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I knew it wasn't easy. So I'll give it a try.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Okay, boo? You decided to stop this time, right? From now on, this space, that is, all spirits in this space, will disturb you. hoot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Got it, boo?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Got it, boo… . No, okay.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Don't copy me, boo. Do you think of me as an owl too, owl?
(The bell on Kronos' head rings slightly. He looks as if he is angry and looks at the distant mountain.)

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Owl or not, I'm busy so that's it. come visit me hoot.
(After finishing speaking, Kronos flaps his wings vigorously and ascends to the sky. Then, he flies over the hill toward somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's the flow of time... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go first. The spirits are already coming, so we have no choice but to get through it... .
(When you escape from the spirits that were chasing Adventurer and reach a quiet space, you can hear the sound of a clock ticking from somewhere.)
Tick. Tick.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Kronos?
(As soon as the name is called, a huge shadow descends from the sky. Kronos, a spirit with the appearance of a large owl clock, still stares at Adventurer with a sullen expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why do you look at me like that?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: This is the original expression, boo. There's nothing I can do about facial expressions like this. hoot. The person who cared about me liked owls... . Why…

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Phew, boo boo.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Now that I think about it, I suddenly remember that you saved the flow of time from going wrong, boo.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: One day, one of the humans was turned into a clock by some force, boo?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… . You mean the magic school festival.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: The power of the magic stone used by the Vice bad guy has infiltrated some of my 'time', boo.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Vice?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: As they dug, the hole was created, and the flow inside it leaked out and affected the Windy Seed, boo. Plus, the guy I think is Zephyrus turned into a clock, boo.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: So I had a lot of trouble. I get scolded by Arche a lot. hoot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: The being who gave Vice the power to interfere with time... , boo.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: That's all I can say about its existence. I can speak if I talk to the goddess, but I can't speak any more if I don't talk to the goddess. hoot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: So please understand, boo.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Got it, boo. No, okay.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Phew, boo. I also talk about all sorts of things. Now that you've come this far, you've felt something, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel strange... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I shook off the spirits and felt an unknown emotion every time I faced them.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I'm glad you felt it, boo.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Still, it's not enough. I can't decide whether to stop Kronos' time or not, boo.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what should I do?
(Kronos’s eyebrows tense in response to %s’s question.)

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: To be honest, I don't care if you never meet Gaia. But, Iris gave you a hard time, so you can't just leave, boo.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I also know that you came here with determination. You know that it's not that easy to get permission, right? hoot?
(Kronos smiles lightly at %s nodding his head silently.)

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I'll check your courage.
(As Kronos raises his wings toward the sky, the realm of time shakes. And his roar, calling out to the spirits, follows.)

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Pour!!

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Ow… .
(Kronos suddenly stops moving and steps back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Kronos?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Do you want to stop, boo.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Fighting has become meaningless, boo. Let's end it like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks, Kronos!

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: But it doesn't stop time, boo.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What if it doesn't stop?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I'll take it slow, boo. You can make it stop, but if you stop, the pneuma collapses.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: As I said before, if a bad guy takes advantage of the opportunity and attacks, there will be negative effects. hoot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Because Etoire and this world are still incomplete without many ancient gods. hoot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know what you mean.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: You said you felt a lot after meeting the spirits, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Kronos.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: What you feel is an emotion. All the emotions of life that feel time... .

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Many people's many emotions are carried in the flowing time and arrive at Pneuma, boo. How to get there is a top secret in spirit business, so it's a secret, boo!

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: It may not be as pretty as Arche, but it's a secret anyway. hoot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Strong but anxious, happy but scared, happy but tired. Those complex and subtle emotions... .

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: It's an obvious story, but this 'time' that the spirits of Pneuma are trying to protect is for Etoire's daily life, boo.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: These spirits keep you feeling positive about life, boo.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Pneuma exists to protect that. hoot. If we stop this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I stop, something big will happen, right?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Just in case, bad guys that even the goddesses don't know about would have sneaked in again. hoot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: No need to be surprised. Because I have confirmed your will, boo. Wait a minute, boo.
(Kronos raises his wings toward the sky once again. Then, the movements of the powerful spirits gradually slow down.)

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: First of all, I made time here slow down. In the meantime, I'll hold on to this moment.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Go to Kairos and convey your will. It won't be easy because he's a tough guy, boo.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks, Kronos!

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I think Kairos might be embarrassed because it’s been a while since he’s seen a human, boo… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Come to think of it, Arche also seemed to say that it had been a long time since she had seen anyone.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Arche is the second, you are the third. hoot. I don't know about the first one, boo.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Now that the work is done, I'm going to work, boo.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I'll let you know when Iris comes here someday, but if Iris, who is not an ancient god, comes, a lot of preparation is needed. hoot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I am a wonderful spirit who focuses on work, boo!
(Kronos suddenly looks up at the sky and frowns.)

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I have a lot to do, so I have to go right away. You should go straight to Arche, boo.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Then cherish your time, boo!
(Kronos quickly flaps his wings and flies across the sky at high speed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel sorry for making you feel busy because of me. Then, should I go out too?

steps.name: for special moments
steps.objective: Defeat [Kairos] in “Time of Kairos” and obtain <Rainbow Hourglass>. Then report the quest to [Arke] in 「Pneuma」.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Did Kronos give permission? The movements of the spirits have slowed down.
(As Arche checks the movements of the spirits around him, he discovers Pneuma's changed appearance.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Rainbow? Hey, there's a rainbow here too.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's been a long time since I came here. First time seeing it.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Ah, rainbow… . Wait a minute, the rainbow is me... . therefore… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It wasn't like this back then... . Calm down, Arche… .
(When Arche is confused, %s can be seen in the distance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche, I'm here. Kronos told me to go. But what's going on?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I… Nothing much happened. What's the big deal?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is this? This silence….)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: If Kronos said that, then you got his permission!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. But what if Kairos is not someone to be taken lightly?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: That's right. It's a formidable spirit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But, where is Kairos? Oh, is this also a secret?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: This isn't a secret. The road to Kairos time... , do you see the hourglass over there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hourglass? I can see it. Is that really the entrance?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes, if you get close, you can naturally go inside.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: If chronos helps us maintain routine time, Kairos creates fateful moments.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Those moments when you make a special choice are Kairos’s responsibility. Maybe the moment of %s's choice contains Kairos' efforts.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm, it looks like nothing much is going on with Arche.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Oh, that's right. Could you please wait a moment?
(Arke takes out a small bottle from between the rocks. Then, he carefully sprinkles it around %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Perfume?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It is a type of perfume made from the leaves of the Actinidia tree that grows in Pneuma. If you want to call Kairos, this is the most effective.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Maybe it's because I'm the spirit of time, but I also need these preparations.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, I will go see Kairos.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Please come back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (There won't be any problems...)
(Arke sees the departing person off and looks at the rainbow in the sky again.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Seeing the rainbow reminds me of the time I walked around with Gaia. ah… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I wasn't like this back then... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: So when I saw %s, was he friendly? ?
(As you approach the hourglass, the scenery in front of you changes little by little, as if you are in another realm.)
(There is a small waterway between the sand dunes of various colors, and trees with red-colored leaves are built around it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess both there and here are areas of time. There's a grandfather clock, here's an hourglass... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, that thing inside the clock isn't sand. Is it water? Water flows out through the broken clock.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to be careful not to fall when moving.
Time flows like water and no one can catch it, so it seems like that here. Haam… .
(When I turn my attention to a voice coming from somewhere, I see something large sitting on a tree.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?
What is it, is this your first time seeing a spirit?
(The being that introduced itself as a spirit falls and lands under the tree.)
Boom.
(The being that appeared with a heavy sound was a huge cat wearing a gown-like dress and holding a shuriken in one hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cat? Oh, no… . Prisoner?
First time seeing a spirit?
(The cat identified as a spirit makes a dissatisfied expression. Then, it suddenly rubs its face with one hand.)
Aren't you mistaken for Pasiphae, which only has a tail and ears?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know Pasiphae?
I'd say he's a distant relative. Because that's not important now. Do you have business for me?
Oh, let me introduce myself. I am Kairos. You are %s, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, to meet Gaia… .

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Just like you did to Kronos, speak comfortably. But sniff. You smell. Did you spray Actinidia perfume?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Arche tells me to spray this and go?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: I already didn't have enough sleep, but the smell was so strong that I woke up. They give you a huge amount of homework... . You, %s… .

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: I really need to meet Gaia, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's what I came here for... .

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Phew… . When Arche asks me to work, I always prepare forsythia perfume. They always say it's a secret... I'm still not getting enough sleep... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Does Kairos like the scent of forsythia?)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Even if it is Gaia's job or Arche's request, time cannot be wasted.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: This place creates special moments in the time given to all living things. If time stops here... ?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: I don't even want to think about it. I've never stopped... .

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Just because I got permission from Kronos doesn't mean I will give it right away. I need to be acknowledged too.
(Kairos lightly jumps up and sits on a large tree branch.)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: If this is fate, then it must be fate, right? As long as you decide to change time like in Chronos' time... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are the spirits coming to stop you again?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: That's right. This space will test you. How fitting you are for this moment... .

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: It will appear when the test is over. In the meantime, I'll be getting some sleep. I woke up because of the forsythia tree. The scent is so strong that it almost clears my clogged nose.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Haam… . See you later then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Kairos, there… .
(Kairos seemed to have no intention of listening to the story in the first place, so he just jumped up and disappeared somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let me listen to the story a little more. Oh, I wonder if the people who stayed behind felt this way when I left in a hurry... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You can feel it yourself in the same way this time, right? Then you have no choice but to try it... .
(The spirits that were chasing Adventurer stop acting as if they had made a promise and then disappear.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what is it?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Haam, didn’t anything happen on your way here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Kairos, where did you come from?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: I was sleeping up there. As expected, the scent of Actinidia was so strong that I couldn't sleep.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: It seems like the spirits understood you and retreated, but I didn't.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Looking at your expression, I can clearly feel the passage of time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel strange... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm scared... , I’m afraid… .

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: In Kronos' time, the range of emotions was probably not wide since it was about everyday things.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: But, it’s different here.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Everyday moments and moments of choice. Let me tell you that the difference is just one piece of paper. You may have regretted your choice, or you may have thought it was excellent.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Such time goes equally to all beings in Etoire, but it is up to each person to use it properly.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Are you still feeling that way?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A little… .
(Kairos' hand pats %s's shoulder comfortingly.)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Now, the cat's hand is the weak hand. What?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: The moment of your choice must have been difficult. All living things are inherently imperfect, but you… .

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Heh… !
(At that moment, Kairos covers his mouth with his hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: As if it was nothing. What am I talking about? What nonsense.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it? Don't pretend you don't know and tell me.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Huh, I can't help it.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: This is probably a time of inevitable choice. deal with me If the result is that you defeat me, what will I tell you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this fate too?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: No, there is no fate in this space. There is only a process of choice and the results that come from that process.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: In time, you will realize whether it was fate or not... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There is no other choice for me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm just here to do what I can.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Yeah?
(Kairos’ eyes turn fierce after confirming %s’s promise.)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Then you will have to deal with it properly.
(Every time Kairos and %s's attacks hit each other, the water on the floor continues to bounce.)
(Meanwhile, Kairos, feeling puzzled, steps back and extends his hand.)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Stop, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: I think this is enough. I guess I've been holding on to you for a long time.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: I didn't know because Kronos never slowed down time. I never thought it would have an impact here too.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Wait a minute.
(With Kairos’ words, the movements of the spirits inside slow down little by little.)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: It has to match Kronos' domain. Otherwise, this place will become unstable too. Oh, and… .
(Kairos looks around and holds up an hourglass. Water and sand are mixed, but unlike other hourglasses here, it emits various lights.)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Give this to Arche.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hourglass?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: … Since I give you permission, you can take it outside. Then there will be a way to meet Gaia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then tell me what you promised.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: What a waste. I was just going to send it back... . Okay, let me tell you. Actually, it's a secret, but I made a mistake.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: The soul you have is more special than anyone else. I can't explain it in words, but... . I don't know how special it is... .

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Just special. So, you could have met many gods and come here, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I feel like there was something more important... .

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: That's all. Because I just manage time. Should I go see Gaia now?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: I hope your choice isn't wrong. So, hurry up and go to Arche.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That said… . Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: I have to do this before these hours return to normal speed. Otherwise, you will be forced to go back without being able to do anything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Then I will go straight to Arche.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: The road to Arche is over there. If you go out there, we can meet you right away.
(Kairos helps %s go out by pushing his back.)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Arche, let %s's steps reach Gaia.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: … Even in the time of Kairos, the movements of the spirits changed. then… %s is… .
(Arke looks around and spots %s returning.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche, I’ve been there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Kairos asked me to give you this, but now how can I meet Gaia?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: What is that?
(Arke receives the hourglass from %s and becomes speechless.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Rainbow colored hourglass... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was an hourglass that contained water and sand, but now that I look at it, it has changed into various lights? When did it change... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: From red to purple? Is it a rainbow?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Rainbow… … .
(Look alternately at the hourglass Arche was holding and the rainbow floating in the sky.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Gaia brought me here... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I had to be here... .
(Arke, who was talking to herself, quietly drops the hourglass she was holding to the floor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche?
(The rainbow inside the broken hourglass begins to flow out and circle around Arche.)
(The light then goes up into the sky and gently touches the rainbow.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Looking at the rainbow, I feel like there are no secrets for me anymore. Before you go to Gaia, would you please listen to my story?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's an important story, right?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes, I am like a key. Oh, it's not a key in any other sense. No, was that there too… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Key….)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I have to open my scattered memories in Pneuma to reach Gaia. This is the method I chose for Gaia... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: About two lives... .

steps.name: Arche's past
steps.objective: Follow [Arke] in “Pneuma” to check out the story of the past. Then report the quest to [Arke] at “The End of the Rainbow.”

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It was no coincidence that I met %s, recognized him, and was happy to see him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I need an explanation. I'm not sure what you mean.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'll tell you everything.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Iris I'm not sure if you want to hear my story... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Because both I and Iris can accept any story.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I really hope so.
(Arke quietly holds %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Now then, please listen to my story.
(As Arche walks slowly holding %s's hand, a completely different picture of the beach comes into view than the atmosphere of Pneuma.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: %s The name of this place you know is ‘Coast of Wailing’, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… . There is a tower of collapse ahead.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: This is where Njord was.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Now, let me tell you a story about a time when I was here a long time ago.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: There were many members of the Der tribe here. The time when I had to make a decision for the world and for Ceres... .
(Arke looks at the sky with sad eyes.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Everyone had the same heart, but the size of that heart was slightly different.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: No matter how much it was done for the future, the fear felt by such a small life was enormous.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: You can't fuse with the Beast... . It belongs to someone whose heart was not strong... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It was the soul of a girl.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The girl's name is Arche... . This is me now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Der people… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: During the fusion process, my soul was severely injured and was thrown away. I wanted to be together again, but I was eaten by the darkness... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I never thought I would hear a story like this.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I don't know where it is, but Gaia pulled me out just before my soul disappeared. They said it wasn't my place and they covered me... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: But at that time, someone attacked Gaia, and Gaia sent me to a safe place. They said they would come back someday... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: In the end, he found me again... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: This is the end of my memories of my first life.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (No way….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, no.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: You were very surprised, right?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Then… Shall we go somewhere else? Please follow me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is Moros… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Even before the Moros Kingdom occupied Moros, this was a place where many people fought. Eastland has been full of all kinds of conflicts for a long time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche, do you know this place?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: This is my second home. I was born in a village in the Oneiro Forest.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: At that time, I guess I wanted to become stronger somehow. Without even remembering my first life... . I was left with the feeling of not being able to help.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: So, I trained hard alone with a sword. However, with my own strength, I can barely withstand the external danger that threatens to attack the village... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Then, a wizard came to me. At that time, one word from the wizard comes to mind.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Oh, it's a boy?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche, wait a minute. So you were a boy then?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Ahaha, I guess so.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The wizard said that if you practice as he said, you can become stronger. Actually, it was borrowing the power of God... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: To become stronger, I followed the wizard to Eastland and Freios and accomplished many things. And little by little, I got stronger.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I met a lot of people and protected a lot of people.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Then, when the wizard was away for a moment, he met a boy wearing a hat on a battlefield.  The boy looked at me and said something strange.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: “I can’t make you the key. Because you have a soul waiting for a sinner... .」

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: “If it’s your sacrifice, nothing will happen for a while.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sacrifice? key?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: With those words, the boy turned into a large animal and bit my neck... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: That's the end of my memories of my second life.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute… . That story… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: That's right. The power of the orb panel used by %s. Because that's my record.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: My name at that time was Weaver… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The wizard came back and took me dead and sent me here.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Gaia… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's too complicated. It's not organized well... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I know you're very embarrassed. But, I had to tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So, Arche was a soul that could not be integrated into the Der tribe, but Gaia saved her? And when I was born again, I was a boy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I trained with Gaia, who transformed into a wizard. Is that the ancient superhuman boy I know?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: A superman is a superman, but not until ancient times. Although the story is a bit older than that of the superhumans except Adrica.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche, or rather, when he was a Weaver, he was bitten and killed by Agashrain Jeril. Wait a minute… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: key… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The soul that awakened after being buried in the eons of time that Weiss talked about... Arche may meet the conditions for the key, but not me...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But why should I….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (By the way, Jeril may have killed the Der people because he is Agashura, but he already knew what Weiss was going to do...)
(Arke, who was looking at %s's complicated expression, quietly holds his hand.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I think I know what you’re thinking.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: My story is not meant to complicate your mind, %s. So don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. I don’t think the things I’ve experienced have anything to do with Arche… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Now you have to meet Gaia. It's finally here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Where is Gaia? I don't think you're here... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here… .

steps.name: Reunion with Gaia
steps.objective: Listen to [Arke] at “The End of the Rainbow” and enter the portal inside.

lines.text: (A sense of heterogeneity comes from the blurry traces of someone's memory mixed with the scenery. Spaces filled with such feelings pass by at a fast pace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Neither Pneuma nor Arche's memory... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's the end of the rainbow.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: When you come to Pneuma, I think it's right to come on a rainbow. I don't remember much, but that's how I felt right now.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: If you go straight that way, you will find Gaia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arke is going with us too.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I also want to see Gaia, but I have to stay here and watch the time.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's okay for me, but Adventurer can't stay here for long... . If the flow of time returns to its original state, then Gaia cannot do anything about it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, I will come and meet Gaia as soon as possible.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'll be waiting here. Come and have a chat.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'll say it again... , I don’t have much time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I’ll keep that in mind… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Gaia….)
(A sense of heterogeneity comes from the blurry traces of someone's memory mixed with the scenery. Spaces filled with such feelings pass by at a fast pace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Neither Pneuma nor Arche's memory... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's the end of the rainbow.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: When you come to Pneuma, I think it's right to come on a rainbow. I don't remember much, but that's how I felt right now.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: If you go straight that way, you will find Gaia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arke is going with us too.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I also want to see Gaia, but I have to stay here and watch the time.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's okay for me, but Adventurer can't stay here for long... . If the flow of time returns to its original state, then Gaia cannot do anything about it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, I will come and meet Gaia as soon as possible.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'll be waiting here. Come and have a chat.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'll say it again... , I don’t have much time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I’ll keep that in mind… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Gaia….)
(All you can see is a space filled with small lights in the darkness like the universe, with the goddess Gaia standing in the distance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gaia.
(No movement is visible to Gaia, as if time has stopped.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gaia… ?
(As her name continues to be called, Gaia's frozen eyes begin to shake and blink.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's me. %s… .  Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm fine. Rather, how can this place be…? . No, this is a place where humans cannot come... . Ah, Iris… .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: If you came here to see me, you must have come with Arche.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: You met Kronos and Kairos, and you must have heard the story of Arche... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris is worried because you disappeared without saying a word.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry. I'll explain everything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, then… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (There are many things I want to ask Gaia.)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry. I couldn't help it. I was planning to meet Iris someday and talk to him, but I don't know when that will happen... .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: As the time to go back to sleep approached, I worried a lot. What can I do to stop the vice?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: With my remaining strength, I couldn't reach Vice's purgatory, where I had strengthened my power with magic stones for a long time... . So I transferred the remaining power to Iris.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Because everyone, including Iris, knew the desire to protect precious places... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was able to do it thanks to Gaia.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Normally, I would have gone to sleep in a place called the sanctuary to recover. But, someone's poison was chasing me, so I had to retreat... .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: So I came to this place that I hadn't visited for a long time.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: This is part of the place where the ancient gods awakened. It is a place where Iris, who has become a star god in a human body, cannot approach.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: If Iris is coming... , you will be threatened by beings who do not acknowledge Iris.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: So I couldn’t tell Iris… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, Gaia. Iris will also understand.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: … After Ceres and Der disappeared, I learned that a soul was trapped. It was Arche.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: While taking out Arche's soul to protect it, it was attacked by the Twisted One. I believe that we will meet again someday... .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: With Adkina's help, the child was able to go to Eastland.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: However, contrary to expectations, it turned out to be a boy named Weaver. That was a bit surprising, but it was okay.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I wanted them to be happy, but Eastland was full of conflict.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Weaver naturally fought with a sword. To protect everyone... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard that you led the way to superhumanity... .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: … I wanted to strengthen that child according to his wishes. As I envision myself playing an active role in this world someday... .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I manifested as a human wizard, helped him solve various problems, and watched him grow stronger.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: But the one day I was briefly separated from Weaver, that day... . Agashura recognized Weaver and killed him... .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: The souls of the Der people sacrificed by Agashura cannot be reborn.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: This is the direction desired by the entity leading this world to destruction. Still, there were exceptions.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I brought you here because I wanted to save the soul I was unable to protect twice. Even though I know I can't be reborn as a human again... .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Because I wanted to let Arche enjoy life. I'm so sorry because that's all I can do in my position... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gaia, Arche will understand.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: And I'll talk about something relevant to %s too.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I believed that the experience Arche had as a weaver would be needed for someone who would one day become the star god of Etoire.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: So I collected them into the orb and waited for the owner to appear. Thank goodness. The orb reached %s, who trusted and comforted Iris... .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Thank you again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, Gaia… .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: A soul awakened after being buried for eternity... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's what Weiss said. And I think it's a continuation of what Jeril said when he bit the Weaver Arche to death.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Jeril has already been aware of the existence of Weiss. And I knew that Arche fit those conditions... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, so please tell me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why I was the key to opening the door to purgatory... .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: If you remember, I've said this before.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: All beings with souls are imperfect. I am also called a god by all living beings... .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: However, %s's soul is imperfect and unstable.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If so, it wouldn't meet the conditions for the former key, right?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: There is a time and space that even the ancient gods do not know about, not only in Etoire but also in other places.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: There are especially many such cases in %s. And you probably already know.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: You from another time... .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Although imperfect and unstable, the same soul continues to exist at various times. Agashura feels it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't believe it, but still... . I think that could happen... .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Agashura is a being designed that way... . Even with the abilities of the ancient gods, I can't tell where they are or what they're doing.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, Gaia… . Don't be too sorry...
(Gaia looks a little distressed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay, Gaia?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm fine. But, I think it's about time... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Already… .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Please continue to adhere to Iris. No, please join us.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: A minuet will be fine. Please talk to me often in the future... . And please tell me I'm sorry... .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I will try to meet you as soon as possible. Oh, I owe a little debt to Ouroboros for this one.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ouroboros?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: So Ouroboros may appear sooner than you think.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: It seems like you're doing something, but I don't know who it's for... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Gaia.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: See you later… . And thank you always.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Don't worry too much. Because I will return healthy... .
(At the end of Gaia's greeting, the flow of air at the end of the rainbow stops. And Gaia's time also does not move, as if it has stopped.)
(Still, the Goddess Butterfly had to see Adventurer off, so it flew in and led him out.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gaia… .

steps.name: To Iris…
steps.objective: If you talk to [Arke] at “The End of the Rainbow,” you can return to [Iris]. And the quest is completed.

lines.text: (%s, who had disappeared between the ends of the rainbow, is slowly revealed, and Arche's eyes, who were waiting, shake slightly.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: %s, you are here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… . He was worried about everyone… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly tell Arche what I talked about with Gaia.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Gaia… .
(Arke is unable to continue speaking with his head down. It only lasts for a moment, then he raises his head again and shows a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Now, %s has no secrets here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The reason I kept it a secret was for Pneuma's sake.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Even so, it wasn't my intention. It doesn't matter though. Everything is for Gaia to protect everything... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Time went back to the way it was. Can you feel it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (An unknown feeling comes over me. This is not something I knew... Maybe it was something Gaia talked about...)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it's nothing. It wasn't like I could feel time or anything. What should I say... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It could be because you came and met Gaia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is that so...)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: %s, I would like to see you again in the future.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I want to do that too. However, Pneuma is a place I cannot easily come to... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Sure. I'm very sorry. Ah, now it's time to go back... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: %s, it was nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Then, I will prepare for %s to return.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: When you return, please say hello to Adkina. And I don't know if I'll meet someone named Jeril... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Please tell me I'm okay with you killing me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems a little difficult to explain the situation, and I don't know where we will meet... . I will definitely tell you.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Thank you, %s. then… Please hold my hand. I'll let you go back now.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Oh, and I have another favor to ask of you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Would you like to be friends with me? I wanted to make friends with people instead of spirits.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's okay with me... . Is that okay?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Of course I like it. Hehe… . Oh, you were with Iris before you came, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Then the time here will bring %s to Iris. Thank you for being my friend... .
(As Arche holds %s's hand, bright lights come from all over the end of the rainbow. And lead everyone somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Uh… ?
(The place seen in front along with Arche's embarrassed voice was Pneuma, the place where Arche was originally located.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is where Arche was originally located... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: What happened? What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The movements of the spirits have also returned properly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: No, it's completely normal. It's strange that Kronos and Kairos are here, though.
(A giant cat with a sullen expression and an owl clock slowly come forward behind Arque, as if they had been waiting.)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Arche, why? You don’t like me being here?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: %s, it was nice to meet Gaia, boo.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: You two caught me, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did Kronos and Kairos stop it?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: It's not like we stopped it.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I don't know what happened, but %s I need you to wake up, boo.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Ah… .
(Arke laughs lightly as if he understood what I meant.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know Arche? Why does it seem like I’m the only one who doesn’t know… . Could you please explain?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's a secret.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was a secret until not long ago. Even though we know it now, is it still a secret?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's rising slightly... . Is it true that you have to enlighten yourself?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: It's the moment of perfect choice.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: If you tried hard, you'd figure it out right away, boo.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's full of pressure.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don’t know what choice it was or what moment it was… . Is it possible that I will be able to go back and forth between Pneuma through this incident? ? Aaaaaaa!!
(As soon as the words are finished, the hidden spirits gather in front of %s. Then, Adventurer is lifted up so that Adventurer can't even properly greet them, and then thrown away into the sky.)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: I realized it sooner than I thought.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I haven't seen many humans, but they sure seem smart, boo.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Will %s come again?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I am a human being who came here by asking God of my own will, Owong. There's plenty of room to come back later, boo.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: That means I have more work to do.
(Arche smiles brightly at the words of Kronos and Kairos.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I guess so... ?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Arche, you have a lot of work to do here in the future. hoot. Kairos, say something too, boo.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Haaaaam, arche. I'm going to sleep. Ah, Kronos turns off the alarm. It's already noisy, so how can I sleep if I don't turn off the alarm?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: What, boo?! I don't like it, boo!

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I can't forgive you for daring to say something about my alarm! hoot! It will keep ringing every minute! On the topic of lazy cats that only eat and sleep!

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: What did you say? Jump on the cliff! owl!

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: It's an owl, it's an owl! No, it's an owl watch, owl!
(While Kronos and Kairos are entangled and fighting each other, Arche quietly looks at the sky where the rainbow has disappeared.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Gaia… .
(Iris quietly looks around. He must have felt that the atmosphere was unusual, so he quickly stretched out his arms.)
(After a while, Adventurer falls gently, feeling like a feather, into the arms of Iris.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… . I feel weird, uh, Iris?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, it's okay.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank goodness. I caught what fell... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? huh… ?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaa!! Sorry!
(Adventurer comes to his senses and steps back in surprise, as if running away.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Why are you so surprised?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And thank you.
(Iris looks at %s's face with a playful expression.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: So, Gaia, what do you think?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's right. Gaia was well. And he told me to say hello to Iris… . What did you say... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Iris about what happened in Pneuma. Meeting a girl named Arche and the Spirit of Time, and meeting Gaia with their help.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Gaia... . For me... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I didn't know. Maybe that’s what you meant… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: And the fact that I, who was born as a human being and am now here, cannot go there... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You did it all for me... . I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Gaia is coming back, so don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: For Gaia's sake, I won't be too gloomy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Aren't you tired?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure. I feel like I've been there for a long time, but it feels like I've been there very briefly.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Is that so? Hehe… .
